environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster but the namespace 'docs-prod' has the label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted applied at the namespace level. The cluster runs Kubernetes 1.28 with PodSecurity admission controller enabled (built-in, not a third-party webhook). Additionally, the namespace has a ResourceQuota that prevents ephemeralStorage requests above 512Mi. The container image is built with a distroless base (gcr.io/distroless/cc-debian12) and the Deployment spec sets securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem: true with runAsNonRoot: true and runAsUser: 65534. The DOCS_ROOT is set to /app/docs which is an emptyDir volume. Note: the restricted Pod Security Standard does NOT validate path contents within allowed volume types, but it does block hostPath volumes entirely and prevents privileged containers, meaning traversal beyond the emptyDir boundary reaches only the container's read-only filesystem layers which contain no sensitive data.
